children: FREQUENCY ELECTRONICS INC reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $23.45M and diluted EPS of $0.41, driven by stronger demand across its product lines and higher-margin program execution versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “diluted income per share”.
Revenue growth of about 70% year-over-year to $23.45M was driven by strong demand across both segments.
Channel mix shifted with satellite programs representing roughly half of revenues and non-space U.S. Government/DoW customers about 47%.
Gross margin improved to 45.8% from 36.8%, attributed to favorable product mix and program maturity efficiencies.
Backlog increased to approximately $129M, with about 67% expected to be realizable within 12 months, supporting near-term production ramp.
Continued investment in R&D and process optimizations to support product leadership and future growth.
